verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an open-finance API platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows APIs that retrieve end-customers' account and transaction data from financial institutions. That is the product's core function, not a documented way for a user to export all their data from Mastercard Open Finance in open formats and leave. No export, bulk-download or offboarding capability appears in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
